metaDescription: Order custom recyclable lanyards and badges for your event. Sustainable, durable, and perfect for eco-conscious branding. Get a quote!
introHtml: Choosing recyclable lanyards and badges means your event or corporate program can reduce waste without sacrificing quality. Made from materials like recycled PET, these lanyards offer the same strength and print clarity as standard options, with the added benefit of being fully recyclable at end of life. Whether you need sublimated full-color designs or simple logo printing, recyclable lanyards let you promote your brand while supporting sustainability goals. Ideal for conferences, trade shows, or employee ID programs.
heroAltText: Custom recyclable lanyards and badges with full-color sublimated print on recycled material
